cards.headline: A review date is the day it happened. Never earlier.
cards.body: Pages that have not been reviewed show the reviewer as staff with no date. We do not backfill dates.

cards.headline: If we cannot check it, it is not on the site.
cards.body: The counts on our About page are computed from the live site each time it renders, so they cannot drift.

cards.headline: A price change is logged only after it is verified.
cards.body: One entry per change: what the listing said before, what it says now, the date and the source.

cards.headline: Six weighted factors. The same rubric for every provider.
cards.body: Medical credibility carries the most weight at 25%. Pricing and value is 20%. No invented ratings, ever.

cards.headline: Published price, times the months you choose.
cards.body: The cost calculator does not estimate, average or add anything. Regular prices sit in their own column.

cards.headline: Read the table as a map, not a verdict.
cards.body: Six variables move the real cost. Our comparison page lists all six, dated and linked. No scores, no ranking.

cards.headline: Three things to verify before you pay any provider.
cards.body: Who reviews and approves your treatment. Which pharmacy fills it. What you will actually pay after the intro price.
